title: Card
description: The bento content card: the card surface (bg-card, separated from the page by tone, no visible border in Flat and Soft) with the style's radius and resting shadow. bordered frames a dense data view; interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item.
when: Group the content of a page in cards; nested facts in TILE (bg-card-field).
bordered for a dense data view (a table or rows that need an edge).
a11y: With onClick the card is a button for keyboards and screen readers (role="button", tab order, Enter / Space, focus ring); active becomes aria-pressed. Never a div with onClick (semi-lint click-target).
A card that opens another page puts a next/link on its title instead of onClick.
notes: It pads itself: padding="card" (p-card, default), "panel" (p-card sm:p-panel) or "none" for an image or table to the edge. Never tighter than p-card (card-padding); a p-* in className replaces the default.
Pass padding and layout only: no bg-* or shadow-* on <Card> (card-class-override).
Light: the card is recessed one step below the app; dark: one step above the panel. A block meant as a card uses bg-card (or Card), never bg-panel: panel is the sidebar / modal step.
